subject: Application for Quality Assurance Lead Role
paragraphs: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Quality Assurance Lead and Senior Software Test Engineer positions. With over seven years of extensive experience leading quality assurance teams and executing robust testing frameworks across global IT firms, I am confident in my ability to drive product excellence and deliver reliable software solutions for your organization.

Throughout my professional career at companies such as Experion Technologies, Quest Global, and UST, I have successfully managed testing operations, designed comprehensive test strategies, and collaborated closely with cross-functional development teams. My expertise spans manual testing, integration and regression testing, defect tracking using JIRA, and implementing test-driven development practices. Currently based in Vaasa as a Master's student in Project Management at VAMK, I bring enhanced organizational and project coordination skills that allow me to align quality metrics tightly with business milestones.

I am fully eligible to work in Finland with a valid student residence permit and am immediately available for full-time or part-time opportunities. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical acumen, leadership background, and dedication to high software standards can contribute to the success of your team.
